In each cell of an n×n board is a lightbulb. Initially, all of the lights are off. Each move consists of changing the state of all of the lights in a row or of all of the lights in a column (off lights are turned on and on lights are turned off). Show that if after a certain number of moves, at least one light is on, then at this moment at least n lights are on.
